name: cafe-portrait
prompt: Create a PORTRAIT 9:16 cinematic photograph using the reference for material and palette continuity. No people, no text, no logos, fine analog grain. Compose specifically for a mobile screen: upper 40 percent is dark negative space, romantic objects clearly visible in the LOWER half with ample margins, no object cropped off. The same rainy late-night cafe: exactly two half-finished ceramic coffee cups, one cream and one oxblood, on a round scratched table. One small red poppy in a clear slender vase. Include both cups completely within the lower third, the vase and flower in the middle right. Dark blue-black wall in upper left, rainy glass on right, warm amber reflected light. The other chair is just visible behind the table. Quiet and intimate.
